## Course Integrity
**This course is compiled automatically on _`r Sys.Date()`_ **
<br>
[![compilation-check](https://github.com/RockefellerUniversity/RU_course_template/actions/workflows/compilation-check.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RockefellerUniversity/RU_course_template/actions/workflows/compilation-check.yml)



**The course is tested and available on MacOS, Windows and Ubuntu Linux for `r R.Version()$version.string`**
<br>
[![OS-check](https://github.com/RockefellerUniversity/RU_course_template/actions/workflows/OS-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RockefellerUniversity/RU_course_template/actions/workflows/OS-check.yaml)


**The course is also tested against every major R release since 3.5 (3.5 &rarr; 4.5) on Linux**
<br>
[![legacy-R-check](https://github.com/RockefellerUniversity/RU_course_template/actions/workflows/legacy-R-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RockefellerUniversity/RU_course_template/actions/workflows/legacy-R-check.yaml)

Previous versions of this course are listed on the [**releases page**](releases.html).
